scope: review of the additive target-object, module-level source-object reconciliation, compiler-generated-code disposition, archive-integrity, external-reference, assurance-record, native-evidence path-hardening, and behavior-neutral benchmark warning-cleanup implementation candidate

implementation_agent.responsibility: prepare the implementation and verification evidence without approving or accepting it

human_reviewer.responsibility: perform the implementation review and decide internal approval or rejection

publication_service_account.responsibility: mechanically publish the approved atomic commit to the DO-178C branch

separation_controls: The implementation agent cannot approve or accept its own candidate.
The human reviewer receives the complete diff, test evidence, limitations, and post-push evidence plan before deciding.
The publication service account is an execution identity and is not treated as the human reviewer or decision maker.
No commit or push occurs until the human reviewer explicitly approves the reviewed implementation candidate.
Clean exact-commit cross-host evidence is evaluated separately after publication and cannot be pre-accepted from dirty local evidence.

conflict_assessment.rationale: The implementation agent and human reviewer act independently in developer and reviewer/approver roles. The shared GitHub service account performs publication only and has no decision authority.

limitations: The human identity and organizational role are self-attested and not externally identity-proofed.
This plan establishes internal role separation only; it is not an authority-approved independence plan.
The human implementation review does not independently reproduce the compiler, LLVM, or archive tools.
non_claims: The GitHub service account is not the reviewer and has no approval authority in this plan.
Internal organizational independence does not establish certification authority acceptance or broader program independence.
